working_title: Your key doesn't push the door open

fact_sources.claim: Key cuts position pin pairs so the cylinder core can turn; the cam actuates the lock bolt.

beats.narration: Your key doesn't push the door open.
beats.visible_action: Hand pulls a key from a pocket toward a locked door

beats.narration: It solves a tiny puzzle inside the lock.
beats.visible_action: Camera follows key into the cylinder, door becomes transparent

beats.narration: Without a key, these pin pairs block the cylinder.
beats.visible_action: Spring-loaded pin pairs cross the highlighted shear line

beats.narration: Each cut on the key lifts a pin a different distance.
beats.visible_action: Key slides in and successive pin pairs rise different amounts

beats.narration: The right key lines every split up with one boundary.
beats.visible_action: All pin-pair splits settle on the shear line

beats.narration: Now the inner cylinder can turn.
beats.visible_action: Core rotates while upper pins stay in the housing

beats.narration: That rotation moves the cam and pulls back the bolt.
beats.visible_action: Cam rotates and retracts the door bolt

beats.narration: The pins line up, the bolt moves, and the door opens.
beats.visible_action: Person opens the door; camera returns to key close-up

loop_resolution: The final key close-up can cut directly to the first frame of the hand holding the same key.
